name: Curse of Mutable Form
body:
Flesh is malleable but sometimes an overindulgence in the change makes it difficult to return to normal.

Bonus Spells: 0th—minor disguise*, 1st—long arm, 2nd—alter self, 3rd—monstrous extremities, 4th—adjustable polymorph

Curse Manifestation

The lathspell exudes an aura of chaotic change. All transmutation spells that change a creature’s form or size or affect their abilities gain +1 caster level if cast within or targeting a creature within 10 feet of the lathspell, including the lathspell themself. However, any such transmutation spell or any shape changing ability within the area of the curse can have unintended consequences. The changes created do not always match what was intended. Anytime a transmutation spell or other ability that changes a creatures form, detriments or enhances physical capabilities, or affects a creature’s size is cast upon a creature within the radius of the curse, roll on Table: Curse of Mutable Form Effect.

The curse has no impact on illusory changes or effects.

Curse Abilities
Beast Skin (Su)

You learn the magic needed to take the form of various animals. You may convert your spell slots into effects which mimic the spells with beast shape in the name. You do so by expending a spell slot and activating this ability, mimicking the corresponding beast shape spell from the following: 1st—beast shape I, 2nd—beast shape II, 3rd—beast shape III, 4th—beast shape IV.

You use your class level to determine the duration of these effects as though you had cast the spell of the same name.

Table: Curse of Mutable Form Effect
d%	Effect
1-50	No change
51-70	Some odd change overcomes the target. Mechanically, this has little effect but it is immediately noticeable to others. The exact nature of the oddity is up to the GM and/or the creature involved but it should be obvious and fun. If the effect grants a disguise bonus, that bonus is halved by the oddity.
71-80	The form assumed is twisted or changed. Any polymorph effect changes the subject to the intended creature, but the form is twisted, they have a -10 to disguise checks when attempting to appear as a typical version of the creature, and they take a -2 penalty to all d20 rolls while in the form due to the pain of the change. Additionally, they are unable to look like a specific creature using such spells. Abilities that affect movement modes or senses affect a randomly determined other sense. Ability enhancements affect another random ability score, and size changes are reversed.
81-90	The effect drastically shifts. Enhancements become penalties and penalties become enhancements. Spells that change form change to a different creature type, roll randomly on the bane weapon magic item table to determine the creature type.
91-100	The spell/ability fails, or ends upon entering the radius of the curse. The creature reverts to their normal form.
Compression (Su)

Your body becomes pliable and incredibly flexible. You can squeeze through cracks and crevices as though you are tiny sized. At 10th level, you may squeeze through spaces as though you are fine sized. This ability affects your held and carried gear as well up to your Medium load.

Controlled Form (Su)

Prerequisite(s) 10th level or higher

You have learned to rein in the volatility of your curse. Whenever you roll the d100 for your manifestation you may choose to add or subtract an amount from the roll up to twice your class level after the results are revealed.

Everchanging Mass (Su)

Prerequisite(s) 6th level or higher

You can change size freely, though it is strenuous.

As a standard action you may change your size by one category smaller or larger. If you become smaller you gain a -2 penalty to Strength and a +2 bonus to Dexterity. If you grow in size you gain a +2 bonus to Strength and a -2 penalty to Dexterity. You may change size any number of times per day but you may only remain in your altered size for a maximum of one minute plus a number of minutes equal to your Constitution modifier. When you revert to your normal form you must wait an amount of time equal to the time spent in your altered form before you may change size again.

Quick Change (Su)

Prerequisite(s) 10th level or higher

Your body adapts to your magic almost instantly.

Whenever you cast a spell of the transmutation school on yourself, you may do so as a swift action regardless of its normal casting time.

Quickened Pulse (Su)

Your body adapts to desperate situations well while you are in an assumed form.

Whenever you are under a transmutation, polymorph or shape changing effect and are under one half your normal maximum hit points you gain fast healing 1. At 4th level and every four levels thereafter this fast healing improves by 1.

Reflexive Hardening (Su)

Prerequisite(s) 6th level or higher

Your body responds to force by adapting quickly. Whenever you are dealt damage by an attack with a natural or manufactured weapon you gain damage reduction equal to 1/2 your lathspell level against attacks of that type for one minute, or until you are dealt damage by an attack of a different type. The damage types are bludgeoning, slashing, and piercing. If a weapon deals multiple types of damage you gain damage reduction against all of them. You can only benefit from one instance of this ability, each time your DR would change, the duration is reset and the DR does not stack.

Shifting Innards (Ex)

Prerequisite(s) 6th level or higher

Your insides often shift and twitch within you making it harder for foes to strike crucial points.

You gain a 25% chance to avoid extra damage from critical hits and precision damage. At 12th level this becomes a 50% chance and at 18th level you become immune to critical hits and precision damage as long as you are conscious and aware of the attacker, as you have learned to control much of your body’s involuntary shifting.

Unnatural Weaponry (Ex/Su)

You can shift your body into various shapes, granting you weapons at a moment’s notice. As a swift action you can change up to two of your limbs into weapons.

Choose a one-handed simple or martial melee weapon, your transformed limb assumes that weapon’s normal statistics based on your size and count as both a natural and manufactured weapon in the same way as a monk’s unarmed strikes. At 3rd level these weapons gain a +1 enhancement bonus, which increases by +1 every 4 levels thereafter.

Violent Reformation (Su)

Your body can violently revert to its natural form. Whenever you are subject to a transmutation effect which alters your form you may choose to end the effect as a purely mental move action, even if you are not the source of the effect. When you end a transmutation effect in this way you shed your previous form with a blast of force dealing 1d6 damage per spell level of the effect (minimum 1d6) to each other creature within a 10-foot radius.

Walking Curse
Master of Many Forms (Su)

Your body truly shapes itself to your will, allowing you to take on forms no one else could. You may now choose the result of the d100 roll for your manifestation. In addition, whenever you are subject to a transmutation effect which would grant you the abilities of a specific creature, you may now choose two forms and gain all the associated abilities of both. For example, were you to be under the effects of a beast shape spell, you would choose two animals and gain all of their associated abilities allowed by the beast shape you are affected by. If you chose the controlled form curse ability, you may replace it with another curse ability.
